import sys
sys.path.insert\(0, "."\)
import cv2
import numpy as np

frame = cv2.imread\("random_frame.png", cv2.IMREAD_COLOR\)
tmpl = cv2.imread\("templates/igt_template_image.png", cv2.IMREAD_COLOR\)
print\(f"Frame: {frame.shape}  Template: {tmpl.shape}"\)

H, W = frame.shape[:2]
top_frac, right_frac = 0.30, 0.50

y0, y1 = 0, int\(round\(top_frac * H\)\)
x0, x1 = int\(round\(right_frac * W\)\), W
search = frame[y0:y1, x0:x1]
print\(f"Search region: x=[{x0},{x1}] y=[{y0},{y1}] shape={search.shape}"\)

search_g = cv2.cvtColor\(search, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
tmpl_g0 = cv2.cvtColor\(tmpl, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)

for s in [0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.5, 2.0]:
    tw = int\(round\(tmpl_g0.shape[1] * s\)\)
    th = int\(round\(tmpl_g0.shape[0] * s\)\)
    if tw < 8 or th < 8 or th >= search_g.shape[0] or tw >= search_g.shape[1]:
        print\(f"  scale={s:.1f}: skip \(tmpl {tw}x{th} vs search {search_g.shape[1]}x{search_g.shape[0]}\)"\)
        continue
    tmpl_g = cv2.resize\(tmpl_g0, \(tw, th\), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA\)
    res = cv2.matchTemplate\(search_g, tmpl_g, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED\)
    _, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc\(res\)
    abs_x = x0 + max_loc[0]
    abs_y = y0 + max_loc[1]
    print\(f"  scale={s:.1f}: score={max_val:.4f}  loc=\({abs_x},{abs_y}\)  tmpl_size=\({tw},{th}\)"\)

# Save the search region with best match marked
best_s = 1.0
tw = int\(round\(tmpl_g0.shape[1] * best_s\)\)
th = int\(round\(tmpl_g0.shape[0] * best_s\)\)
tmpl_g = cv2.resize\(tmpl_g0, \(tw, th\), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA\)
res = cv2.matchTemplate\(search_g, tmpl_g, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED\)
_, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc\(res\)

vis = search.copy\(\)
cv2.rectangle\(vis, max_loc, \(max_loc[0]+tw, max_loc[1]+th\), \(0,0,255\), 2\)
cv2.putText\(vis, f"s=1.0 score={max_val:.3f}", \(max_loc[0], max_loc[1]-5\),
            cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5, \(0,0,255\), 1\)
cv2.imwrite\("debug/anchor_search_region.png", vis\)
print\(f"\\nSaved search region with match to debug/anchor_search_region.png"\)

import sys
sys.path.insert\(0, "."\)
import json, cv2, numpy as np, torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from pathlib import Path
from src.timer.model import TinyCharCNN
from src.timer.infer import _prep_digit_for_model

frame = cv2.imread\("random_frame.png", cv2.IMREAD_COLOR\)
H, W = frame.shape[:2]
print\(f"Frame: {W}x{H}"\)

# Use TRAINING configs \(roi.json timer + timer_digit_bounds.json\)
roi_cfg = json.loads\(Path\("configs/roi.json"\).read_text\(\)\)["timer"]
x0 = int\(roi_cfg["x0"] * W\); y0 = int\(roi_cfg["y0"] * H\)
x1 = int\(roi_cfg["x1"] * W\); y1 = int\(roi_cfg["y1"] * H\)
timer_roi = frame[y0:y1, x0:x1].copy\(\)
print\(f"Training ROI: \({x0},{y0}\)-\({x1},{y1}\) = {timer_roi.shape}"\)
cv2.imwrite\("debug/training_roi_timer.png", timer_roi\)

# Load digit bounds from training config
dcfg = json.loads\(Path\("configs/timer_digit_bounds.json"\).read_text\(\)\)
bounds = dcfg["digit_bounds_x_norm_within_timer"]
seps = dcfg["separators_x_norm_within_timer"]

TH, TW = timer_roi.shape[:2]
colon0_px = int\(round\(seps["colon"][0] * TW\)\)
colon1_px = int\(round\(seps["colon"][1] * TW\)\)
dot0_px = int\(round\(seps["dot"][0] * TW\)\)
dot1_px = int\(round\(seps["dot"][1] * TW\)\)

# Crop and classify digits
model = TinyCharCNN\(\)
model.load_state_dict\(torch.load\("timer_model.pth", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True\)\)
model.eval\(\)

for i in range\(7\):
    bx0 = int\(round\(bounds[i] * TW\)\)
    bx1 = int\(round\(bounds[i+1] * TW\)\)
    if i == 1: bx1 = min\(bx1, colon0_px\)
    elif i == 2: bx0 = max\(bx0, colon1_px\)
    elif i == 3: bx1 = min\(bx1, dot0_px\)
    elif i == 4: bx0 = max\(bx0, dot1_px\)
    bx0 = max\(0, min\(TW-1, bx0\)\)
    bx1 = max\(1, min\(TW, bx1\)\)
    
    crop = timer_roi[:, bx0:bx1].copy\(\)
    cv2.imwrite\(f"debug/training_digit_{i}.png", crop\)
    
    x = _prep_digit_for_model\(crop, out_size=32\)
    x_t = torch.from_numpy\(x\).unsqueeze\(0\).float\(\)
    logits = model\(x_t\)
    probs = F.softmax\(logits, dim=1\)
    conf, pred = probs.max\(dim=1\)
    top3 = torch.topk\(probs, 3, dim=1\)
    top3_str = ", ".join\([f"{top3.indices[0,k].item\(\)}\({top3.values[0,k].item\(\):.3f}\)" for k in range\(3\)]\)
    print\(f"  d{i}: crop={crop.shape} pred={pred.item\(\)} conf={conf.item\(\):.4f}  top3=[{top3_str}]"\)

import sys
sys.path.insert\(0, "."\)
import cv2, numpy as np, torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from src.timer.model import TinyCharCNN
from src.timer.infer import \(
    load_timer_layout, _match_anchor_multiscale,
    _timer_xyxy_from_anchor, _crop_xyxy, _digit_boxes_excluding_seps,
    _letterbox, clamp,
\)

frame = cv2.imread\("random_frame.png", cv2.IMREAD_COLOR\)
H, W = frame.shape[:2]
layout = load_timer_layout\("configs/timer_layout_from_anchor.json"\)
anchor_tmpl = cv2.imread\(layout.anchor_template_path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR\)

found = _match_anchor_multiscale\(frame, anchor_tmpl, layout.match_top_frac, layout.match_right_frac\)
score, anchor_xywh = found
timer_xyxy = _timer_xyxy_from_anchor\(anchor_xywh, layout\)
tx0, ty0, tx1, ty1 = timer_xyxy
tw, th = tx1 - tx0, ty1 - ty0
print\(f"Original timer: \({tx0},{ty0}\)-\({tx1},{ty1}\) = {tw}x{th}"\)

digit_boxes = _digit_boxes_excluding_seps\(
    timer_xyxy, layout.digit_bounds, layout.colon_band, layout.dot_band
\)

model = TinyCharCNN\(\)
model.load_state_dict\(torch.load\("timer_model.pth", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True\)\)
model.eval\(\)

# Try different vertical extension factors
for vpad_factor in [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5]:
    vpad = int\(th * vpad_factor\)
    results = []
    for i, \(bx0, by0, bx1, by1\) in enumerate\(digit_boxes\):
        # extend vertically
        ey0 = clamp\(by0 - vpad, 0, H - 1\)
        ey1 = clamp\(by1 + vpad, 1, H\)
        crop = frame[ey0:ey1, bx0:bx1].copy\(\)

        # pad_to_square then resize \(matching training preprocessing\)
        h2, w2 = crop.shape[:2]
        m = max\(h2, w2\)
        sq = np.zeros\(\(m, m, 3\), dtype=np.uint8\)
        y0 = \(m - h2\) // 2
        x0 = \(m - w2\) // 2
        sq[y0:y0+h2, x0:x0+w2] = crop
        sq32 = cv2.resize\(sq, \(32, 32\), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA\)
        
        # 3-channel preprocessing
        gray = cv2.cvtColor\(sq32, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
        b = sq32[:,:,0].astype\(np.int16\)
        g = sq32[:,:,1].astype\(np.int16\)
        r = sq32[:,:,2].astype\(np.int16\)
        mask = \(np.clip\(np.minimum\(r,g\) - b, 0, 255\).astype\(np.uint8\) >= 40\).astype\(np.uint8\) * 255
        gray_m = cv2.bitwise_and\(gray, gray, mask=mask\)
        gx = cv2.Sobel\(gray_m, cv2.CV_32F, 1, 0, ksize=3\)
        gy = cv2.Sobel\(gray_m, cv2.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize=3\)
        mag = np.clip\(cv2.magnitude\(gx, gy\), 0, 255\).astype\(np.uint8\)
        x = np.stack\([gray.astype\(np.float32\)/255, mag.astype\(np.float32\)/255, mask.astype\(np.float32\)/255]\)
        
        x_t = torch.from_numpy\(x\).unsqueeze\(0\).float\(\)
        logits = model\(x_t\)
        probs = F.softmax\(logits, dim=1\)
        conf, pred = probs.max\(dim=1\)
        results.append\(f"{pred.item\(\)}"\)
    
    text = f"{results[0]}{results[1]}:{results[2]}{results[3]}.{results[4]}{results[5]}{results[6]}"
    print\(f"vpad={vpad_factor:.1f} \({vpad}px\): {text}"\)
